purpose: Human-authored identity decisions applied downstream without modifying the workbook, analyzer output, or collision-review artifacts.

source_contract.required_match: Match review_signature first, then require exact equality of the sorted source_identity_keys. Reject application if the workbook SHA-256 or parser version differs unless a human explicitly revalidates the decision set.

MERGE.effect: Map every source_identity_key in the group to one selected canonical source identity.
MERGE.validation: canonical_source_identity_key must be one of source_identity_keys; approved_canonical_f3_display_name must be non-empty.

KEEP_SEPARATE.effect: Preserve every source_identity_key independently with its existing proposed identity and display name.
KEEP_SEPARATE.validation: canonical_source_identity_key and approved_canonical_f3_display_name must remain null.

UNRESOLVED.effect: Preserve every source identity independently and retain the collision for future review; do not merge.
UNRESOLVED.validation: canonical_source_identity_key and approved_canonical_f3_display_name must remain null.
